name: tuned-tensor
description: Codex plugin for local-first or managed Tuned Tensor fine-tuning, evaluation, and local serving.

interface.shortDescription: Build and operate Tuned Tensor behaviour specs.
interface.longDescription: Helps Codex choose TT Local for local-first training/evaluation or the managed tt CLI for account-backed runs, then serve completed models locally through an OpenAI-compatible API.
defaultPrompt: Fine-tune a Tuned Tensor model from this behaviour spec.
Serve this Tuned Tensor model locally on port 8000.
Inspect my Tuned Tensor run report and summarize regressions.
